    Maps from band modules #

    Let ι : V → M land in the numerator at the first position of a band b, and let φ be an automorphism of V such that ι y is joined to ι (φ y) by a chain along one period. Then a linear choice of such chains gives a module map from the band module M(b, V, φ) to M restricting to ι on the block at the first position (exists_bandHom).
